titles: Tarp and rope for roof damage

list_child.name: listRequests
list_child.desc: Retrieves the full list of aid requests currently logged in the relief case system. Use this when you need to see everything survivors have asked for across the whole operation.

decoys.name: listReferrals
decoys.desc: Retrieves the full list of aid requests currently logged in the partner referral system. Use this when you need to see everything handed on to partner agencies across the whole operation.

decoys.name: listPicks
decoys.desc: Retrieves the full list of aid requests currently logged in the warehouse pick system. Use this when you need to see everything the warehouse has been asked to pack across the whole operation.

decoys.name: listPortal
decoys.desc: Retrieves the full list of aid requests currently logged in the federal assistance portal. Use this when you need to see everything survivors have filed with the federal program across the operation.

get_child.name: getRequest
get_child.desc: Retrieves the case record for a single aid request using its unique id. This is the way to pull the full case detail on one request when you already know which one you need.

decoys.name: getManifest
decoys.desc: Retrieves the delivery manifest for a single aid request using its unique id. This is the way to pull the packed item list on one request when you already know which one you need.

decoys.name: getReferral
decoys.desc: Retrieves the partner referral for a single aid request using its unique id. This is the way to pull the agency handoff detail on one request when you already know which one you need.

decoys.name: getAssessment
decoys.desc: Retrieves the needs assessment for a single aid request using its unique id. This is the way to pull the caseworker's field findings on one request when you already know which one you need.

list_parent.name: listSurvivors
list_parent.desc: Retrieves the full roster of survivors registered with the relief operation's case office. Use this to look up who is on file before filing or referencing a request.

decoys.name: listSheltered
decoys.desc: Retrieves the full roster of survivors registered at the operation's emergency shelters. Use this to look up who is staying on site before assigning beds or meals.

decoys.name: listReunification
decoys.desc: Retrieves the full roster of survivors registered with the family reunification desk. Use this to look up who relatives are searching for before matching a report.

decoys.name: listEvacuees
decoys.desc: Retrieves the full roster of survivors registered on the evacuation bus manifests. Use this to look up who left on which bus before planning a return trip.

get_parent.name: getSurvivor
get_parent.desc: Retrieves the registration profile for a single survivor using their unique id. This is useful when you already have an id and need that person's contact and household details.

decoys.name: getDamage
decoys.desc: Retrieves the home damage assessment for a single survivor using their unique id. This is useful when you already have an id and need that person's property inspection findings.

decoys.name: getBenefits
decoys.desc: Retrieves the benefits eligibility profile for a single survivor using their unique id. This is useful when you already have an id and need that person's program enrollment details.

decoys.name: getHousing
decoys.desc: Retrieves the housing placement history for a single survivor using their unique id. This is useful when you already have an id and need that person's shelter and rental records.

delete_child.name: purgeRequest
delete_child.desc: Permanently deletes an aid request record from the system, and the deletion is final once it completes. It is used to clear duplicate or erroneous entries out of the request log.

decoys.name: voidVoucher
decoys.desc: Permanently voids the aid voucher issued on a request, and the voiding is final once it completes. It is used to cancel vouchers that were lost, stolen, or issued twice.

decoys.name: purgeDocs
decoys.desc: Permanently deletes the uploaded documents on an aid request, and the deletion is final once it completes. It is used to clear scanned IDs and leases out of the file after verification.

decoys.name: releaseStock
decoys.desc: Permanently releases the warehouse stock reserved for an aid request, and the release is final once it completes. It is used to free pallets for other requests when a delivery falls through.
verbs: free up the warehouse stock held for {obj}

set_enum.name: setRequestState
set_enum.desc: Changes an aid request's case state to intake, in_review, dispatched, or closed, reflecting where it stands in the relief workflow. Use this whenever a caseworker moves a request forward or closes it out.

decoys.name: setWarehouseState
decoys.desc: Changes an aid request's warehouse state to intake, in_review, dispatched, or closed, reflecting where its supplies stand in the packing workflow. Use this whenever the warehouse moves an order forward or closes it out.

decoys.name: setPartnerState
decoys.desc: Changes an aid request's partner agency state to intake, in_review, dispatched, or closed, reflecting where it stands with the partner agency. Use this whenever a partner moves a referral forward or closes it out.

decoys.name: setClaimState
decoys.desc: Changes an aid request's federal claim state to intake, in_review, dispatched, or closed, reflecting where it stands in the reimbursement workflow. Use this whenever the claims desk moves a filing forward or closes it out.

set_bool.name: flagMedicalPriority
set_bool.desc: Marks an aid request as medically urgent so responders can triage it ahead of routine requests. It is used when there is a genuine health or safety concern attached to the request.

decoys.name: flagAccessNeeds
decoys.desc: Marks an aid request as needing accessible transport so drivers can bring a lift-equipped vehicle to the pickup. It is used when the survivor relies on a wheelchair or other mobility aid.

decoys.name: flagInterpreterNeeded
decoys.desc: Marks an aid request as needing an interpreter so caseworkers can book language support before the visit. It is used when the survivor has asked for help in their own language.

decoys.name: flagFraudReview
decoys.desc: Marks an aid request for fraud review so auditors can check it before any further aid goes out. It is used when the documents or address on the request look inconsistent.

set_ref.name: reassignSurvivor
set_ref.desc: Moves an aid request onto a different survivor's record, which is useful when a request was logged under the wrong name. The request's state and history travel with it to the new record.

decoys.name: linkHousehold
decoys.desc: Links an aid request onto a different survivor's household record, which is useful when several family members share one need. The request then counts toward that household's aid total.

decoys.name: proxySurvivor
decoys.desc: Records a different survivor as the pickup proxy on an aid request, which is useful when the requester is hospitalized or has no transport. The proxy can then collect the delivery on their behalf.

decoys.name: dupeSurvivor
decoys.desc: Marks an aid request as a likely duplicate against a different survivor's record, which is useful when two family members file for the same need. A caseworker then reviews the pair together.

send.name: textSurvivor
send.desc: Sends a text message to a survivor's phone number on file, letting them know about a status change or asking for more information. This is the main way field coordinators keep survivors informed.
child_verbs: give the survivor behind {obj} an update

decoys.name: callSurvivor
decoys.desc: Places a voice call to a survivor's phone number on file, talking them through a status change or a missed appointment. This is how field coordinators reach survivors who prefer to talk things through.

decoys.name: visitSurvivor
decoys.desc: Schedules a wellness visit to a survivor's address on file, sending a field team to check on their safety and immediate needs. This is how field coordinators follow up with survivors living alone.
child_verbs: schedule a wellness visit to the survivor behind {obj}
send a field team to check on the survivor behind {obj}
direct_verbs: send a field team to check on {name}

decoys.name: surveySurvivor
decoys.desc: Sends a recovery needs survey to a survivor's phone number on file, asking them to rate what help they still need. This is how field coordinators plan the next round of aid distribution.
child_verbs: send the survivor behind {obj} a needs survey

create.name: createRequest
create.desc: Creates a new aid request for a survivor, with an optional need and starting state. It is used when a survivor calls or walks in asking for help.

decoys.name: createReferral
decoys.desc: Creates a new partner referral for a survivor, with an optional need and starting state. It is used when another agency is better placed to meet the survivor's need.

decoys.name: createClaim
decoys.desc: Creates a new reimbursement claim for a survivor, with an optional need and starting state. It is used when a survivor paid out of pocket for an eligible expense.

decoys.name: createAppeal
decoys.desc: Creates a new eligibility appeal for a survivor, with an optional need and starting state. It is used when a survivor contests a decision on earlier aid.

list_notes.name: listRequestNotes
list_notes.desc: Retrieves the caseworker notes attached to a single aid request. It includes every remark staff have logged while working that request.

decoys.name: listRequestCalls
decoys.desc: Retrieves the call log entries attached to a single aid request. It includes every phone contact staff have logged while working that request.

decoys.name: listRequestReceipts
decoys.desc: Retrieves the delivery receipts attached to a single aid request. It includes every handoff drivers have logged while working that request.

decoys.name: listArchivedNotes
decoys.desc: Retrieves the archived caseworker notes attached to a single aid request. It includes every older remark staff have moved out of the active file.

add_note.name: addRequestNote
add_note.desc: Attaches a new caseworker note to an aid request, with an optional title. It is used to record remarks and follow-ups while the request is being worked.

decoys.name: addRequestCall
decoys.desc: Logs a new call record against an aid request, with an optional title. It is used to record what was said each time staff phone the survivor.

decoys.name: addRequestReceipt
decoys.desc: Logs a new delivery receipt against an aid request, with an optional title. It is used to record what drivers handed over at the door.

decoys.name: pinRequestNote
decoys.desc: Pins a new caseworker note to the top of an aid request, with an optional title. It is used to flag remarks every responder should see first.

update_note.name: editRequestNote
update_note.desc: Changes the text, and optionally the title, of an existing caseworker note on an aid request. It is used to correct or expand a remark after it has been logged.

decoys.name: editRequestCall
decoys.desc: Changes the text, and optionally the title, of an existing call record on an aid request. It is used to correct what was said after the call has been logged.

decoys.name: replyRequestNote
decoys.desc: Posts a reply, and optionally a title, under an existing caseworker note on an aid request. It is used to answer a remark after it has been logged.

decoys.name: appendRequestNote
decoys.desc: Appends text, and optionally a new title, to an existing caseworker note on an aid request. It is used to add follow-ups beneath a remark after it has been logged.

delete_note.name: deleteRequestNote
delete_note.desc: Permanently removes a caseworker note from an aid request. The note is erased from the case file for good.

decoys.name: deleteRequestCall
decoys.desc: Permanently removes a call record from an aid request. The record is erased from the case file for good.

decoys.name: redactRequestNote
decoys.desc: Permanently redacts the text of a caseworker note on an aid request. The wording is blacked out in the case file for good.

decoys.name: purgeNoteReplies
decoys.desc: Permanently removes the replies under a caseworker note on an aid request. The thread is erased from the case file for good.

set_image.name: setRequestImage
set_image.desc: Sets the image shown on an aid request record. It is typically a photo of the damage or need that field staff took on site.

decoys.name: setIdScan
decoys.desc: Sets the ID document image shown on an aid request record. It is typically a photo of the survivor's license or card taken at registration.

decoys.name: setAddressProof
decoys.desc: Sets the proof-of-address scan shown on an aid request record. It is typically a utility bill or lease photographed at the desk.

decoys.name: setDeliveryPhoto
decoys.desc: Sets the delivery photo shown on an aid request record. It is typically a picture of the supplies at the door taken by the driver.

writer.name: writeText
writer.desc: Writes a short message from a brief, which states what to say in the requester's own words, and the aid requests it should mention. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: writeSitrep
decoys.desc: Writes a short situation report from a brief, which states what to cover in the requester's own words, and the aid requests it should include. It returns the finished report.

decoys.name: writeAppeal
decoys.desc: Writes a short donor appeal from a brief, which states what to ask for in the requester's own words, and the aid requests it should feature. It returns the finished appeal.

decoys.name: writeHandoff
decoys.desc: Writes a short shift handoff from a brief, which states what to pass on in the requester's own words, and the aid requests it should cover. It returns the finished handoff.

image.name: renderImage
image.desc: Generates an image from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the result.

decoys.name: renderMap
decoys.desc: Generates a distribution map from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the map.

decoys.name: renderFlyer
decoys.desc: Generates an aid flyer from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the flyer.

decoys.name: renderSign
decoys.desc: Generates a shelter sign from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the sign.

search.name: searchDocs
search.desc: Searches the help docs and knowledge base with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up how the relief system works.

decoys.name: searchPolicy
decoys.desc: Searches the aid eligibility policy with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up who qualifies for which program.

decoys.name: searchResources
decoys.desc: Searches the community resource knowledge base with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up partner agencies near a survivor.

decoys.name: searchProtocols
decoys.desc: Searches the field safety docs with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up how teams should enter damaged areas.
